headline: Two counts of the dead, two counts of the missing
deck: Guides and kitchen staff are named by one tally; police give a smaller missing number and no jobs.
body: The Nepal National Mountain Guide Association said two climbing guides were found dead and 14 kitchen staff remain missing after an avalanche struck Himlung Himal Base Camp in Manang on Sunday. Police, as quoted by News18, put the same Sunday avalanche at two killed and 10 still missing. [E2][E3]
The occupation split is the guides association's: two climbing guides dead, fourteen kitchen staff unaccounted for. Police named no jobs. The two counts of the dead agree; the missing do not.
